 News On AIR | 
 November 17, 2026 8:16 AM 
 Defending champions India to face Pakistan in SAFF Championship final in Dhaka today
 In Football, defending champions India will take on Pakistan in the final of the SAFF Championship at the National Stadium in Dhaka, Bangladesh, today. India will be aiming to secure their 10th overall SAFF Championship title and make history by winning the tournament for the third consecutive time. The Blue Tigers booked their place in the final after defeating Bhutan 2-1 in the semi-final on Saturday. 
 Pakistan, meanwhile, will be making their first-ever appearance in a SAFF Championship final. The two sides have met 30 times in senior internationals, with India winning 17 matches, Pakistan four and nine ending in draws. Today’s clash will, however, be their first meeting in a senior SAFF Championship final. 
 India are the most successful team in the tournament’s history, having won a record nine titles, and they are the favourites to lift the trophy once again.
